findings_and_reconnections.status: documentation/source qualification, connected to prior current numerical finding
findings_and_reconnections.trace: Current README states output normals are accumulated from deformed triangles and normalized. Mhr::vertex_normals indeed accumulates face cross products, but returns a zero normal for an unreferenced vertex and divides by max(length,1e-12); a tiny nonzero accumulated normal can thus remain non-unit. MhrOutput similarly says unit normals.
findings_and_reconnections.conditions: An unreferenced/degenerate vertex or unusually tiny nonzero accumulated area; ordinary asset geometry and GPU backend behavior were not validated. Symbolic tiny right-triangle witness and numeric precision limits were previously recorded in model-tiny-triangle-normal, not re-executed here. Do not claim every output is non-unit.
findings_and_reconnections.historical_relationship: Prior local mhr-model report model-tiny-triangle-normal already owns the numeric aspect; this is the README/API wording relationship, not a separate automatically unique product finding. Earlier 059 Q-L12-2544938d5b3d61f1c490 asked for README normal reconciliation; its historical README is a different 6533 body.
findings_and_reconnections.future_repair_direction: Document the actual zero/tiny-normal behavior and resolve the existing numerical owner/scale policy together; preserve intentional zero for unreferenced geometry.

findings_and_reconnections.status: historical distinct first-failure records independently reconnected to current support
findings_and_reconnections.trace: When both direct and nested asset reads fail, from_uri formats both errors into a new anyhow message; their original typed branch errors are no longer in that new error chain. It also formats String::from_utf8’s FromUtf8Error into a new message. The bounded FS source shows read_bytes can propagate errors from a project DirectoryEntry/FileEntry; its NativeFile implementation itself formats the std::io error earlier.
findings_and_reconnections.conditions: Only a branch error that still has a structured cause at the MHR boundary can be lost there; native providers may have already erased a cause. Both locations and rendered diagnostics remain in the message. No file, browser or network operation was run.
findings_and_reconnections.historical_relationship: Exact recorded q421 SEGOVB-L12-MHR-ASSET-FALLBACK-CAUSES-ERASURE and q422 SEGOVB-L12-MHR-DEFINITION-UTF8-CAUSE-ERASURE, connected to broader q173 ADLER-L11-MHR-LOAD-ERROR-OWNERSHIP; q311/q312 record independent upstream FS first failures. Do not merge distinct first cuts or assert a new count.
findings_and_reconnections.future_repair_direction: Preserve both attempted locations and both actual branch causes in a structured failure, and retain the concrete UTF-8 source; reconcile upstream FS cause ownership separately.

findings_and_reconnections.status: source-established per-file lookup behavior; same-cohort policy unresolved
findings_and_reconnections.trace: from_files selects one asset directory by the model-definition file before opening the FBX and other inputs. from_uri instead tries direct and nested locations independently for each file, so successful inputs may come from a mixture of the base and its assets/ child. Subsequent count checks do not by themselves prove all files originate from the same authored rig.
findings_and_reconnections.conditions: Some requested files exist in the base and others only in its nested assets/ directory, and both individual reads succeed. Whether this is a supported composition or an unwanted mismatch requires owner policy and actual producer evidence; no particular asset or runtime failure is claimed.
findings_and_reconnections.historical_relationship: Connected to existing Q-L12-88ec94bbbe49252b389b URI composition and q170 ADLER-L11-MHR-MODEL-SHAPE-LIFETIME, but no exact identity/duplicate is established. README documents available inputs, not an explicit cross-directory identity guarantee.
findings_and_reconnections.future_repair_direction: Decide whether a model load must bind to one selected source directory or an explicitly admitted asset cohort, then trace URI producers and preserve supported parent/assets layouts.

metadata_and_documentation_observations.observation: Current MHR Cargo.toml adds a direct derive_more dependency and a dev profile compared with 6533, retains its own [workspace], Burn git revision and pliron patch. The personally displayed current lock MHR block contains derive_more; selected Burn and pliron blocks carry the same exact Git revisions in both displayed revisions. This is scoped byte evidence only; it does not prove a complete lock delta, successful dependency resolution, compiler features, or a reproducible build.

The mesh manifest is unchanged and defaults to its gpu feature; dependency declarations are optional under that feature. Bounded MeshData source guards GPU-specific imports and upload/read functions with cfg(feature="gpu"). This source pattern is not proof any feature combination compiles.

Source supports LOD 4–6 defaulting to 4 with correctives enabled; from_asset_bytes names activation and basis roles; corrective layout checks expected basis axes, vertex/hidden counts and checked products, and CorrectiveInput checks joint and channel extents. ParameterMatrix checks allocation shape and nonshrinking/prefix width. These are bounded source facts, not a claim of full asset, identity, allocator or GPU validation.

Corrective archive member array() errors locally receive anyhow context; the inspected MHR boundary uses ? for archive open/from-bytes. This does not prove all underlying NumPy/ZIP/native implementations retain their causes. URI fallback and UTF-8 handling have separate erasure paths noted above.

lens_perspectives.name: admission
lens_perspectives.assessment: The locally traced corrective and matrix shape guards match bounded README claims; full decoder, allocation, native types and all input admission remain separate.

lens_perspectives.name: invariant operations
lens_perspectives.assessment: The normal denominator floor creates a real distinction between nonzero and unit vectors at tiny scale; previously recorded numerical source candidate remains conditional.

lens_perspectives.name: aggregate states
lens_perspectives.assessment: URI fallback can combine sources from two directory levels; whether an asset cohort must share provenance is open. Matching individual dimensions alone does not establish rig/mesh identity.

lens_perspectives.assessment: MHR-local semantic types and generic fabelgeist-mesh data have distinct representations. Historical rig/root supplier labels are source responsibility, not an automatic repair-owner transfer.

lens_perspectives.assessment: Mhr retains public Character while caching face tensors; the prior local model and character reports retain the specific lifetime issue. No new cache claim follows from README text alone.

lens_perspectives.name: behavior preservation
lens_perspectives.assessment: Preserve native direct/nested asset layouts, optional corrective policy, zero/degenerate normals, count-versus-identity distinctions and semantic error causes. Historical removed examples or old claims do not establish current behavior.

lens_perspectives.name: enum shapes
lens_perspectives.assessment: Existing named CorrectiveArchiveBytes separates activation and basis; a boolean pose_correctives retains an optional loading mode whose wider API policy remains separate. No additional enum finding is asserted.

lens_perspectives.name: derivability
lens_perspectives.assessment: Current manifest enables derive_more and inspected MeshVertexTable/types use derives. Historical or current lock listing is not itself proof that every handwritten trait is removable.

lens_perspectives.name: type granularity
lens_perspectives.assessment: Count/ordinal types are separate from per-instance membership; dense matrix and corrective shape checks do not certify rig identity, scalar finiteness or asset origin. Historical e275 README qualification retains its own revision.

lens_perspectives.name: raw strings
lens_perspectives.assessment: URI fallback and UTF-8 errors still flatten distinct native causes; exact historical first-failure identities and earlier FS erasure remain separate. Cargo dependency names, paths and source URLs are native format literals.

lens_perspectives.name: raw primitives
lens_perspectives.assessment: Lengths 45/72 are specific blend-shape roles, model P and J are asset-derived, and 1e-12 has a normal-magnitude purpose with an explicit tiny-scale limitation. No blanket magic-number substitution.
